description: This line plot illustrates the similarity scores across different layers for four distinct model configurations, labeled en&en, en&es, en&el, and en&bn, as indicated in the legend. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 22, with integer tick marks at regular intervals. The y-axis represents similarity, scaled linearly from 0.00 to 0.45. The red solid line, corresponding to en&en, begins near a similarity of 0.07 at layer 0, rises to a peak of approximately 0.26 at layer 6, then declines to about 0.14 at layer 12 before sharply increasing again to nearly 0.45 at layer 22. The blue dashed line, for en&es, starts near 0.05, rises to approximately 0.25 at layer 6, and then gradually declines to about 0.05 at layer 22. The green dashed line, en&el, begins near 0.04, peaks at around 0.15 at layer 12, and then declines to approximately 0.05 at layer 22. The pink dashed line, en&bn, starts near 0.04, rises to about 0.14 at layer 6, dips to a low near 0.08 at layer 8, and then increases to nearly 0.30 at layer 22.
